trajectory_summary: The call opens on a withdrawal that Holland successfully reverses with a quick boundary correction, and the verify section runs smoothly through ownership, roof, and bill capture. But once the customer presses for a price floor, the rep repeats the same non-answer instead of flipping the bill or redirecting to the specialist, and the call ends in a vague callback promise with no locked time.
outcome_dispute: No appointment was booked or even tentatively scheduled — the customer deferred to call back after discussing with her spouse, and the rep never proposed a specific day/time, so this should read as callback/no_appointment rather than any booked outcome.
